plugin.marketplace: local filesystem marketplace pointing at jianyingcraft-plugin

live_call.note: ZCode's headless CLI does not render the MCP Apps panel, so open_editor alone never flips ready. The acceptance prompt writes the editorUrl to a file and sleeps; an external Chrome loads it; the panel then polls, ready becomes true, and command_run succeeds.

screen_evidence.shows: Chrome window running the jianyingcraft panel (Properties / Essential Graphics / Text docks and timeline) next to the ZCode desktop window

gaps: The panel screenshot tool (screenshot) fails with 'bridge queue is full' inside ZCode, and its MCP schema has no path argument. Needs investigation.
The headless CLI needs an external browser to mount the panel; the desktop app may host it directly but that was not exercised.
ZCode CLI on a plain node host needs the bundled provider config copied to D:\config\provider\zcode-builtin.json (packaging quirk, warn only).
